Collapsed Core: Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a *Collapsed Core*, which transforms into a *Flare Star Butterfly* after 6s. *Flare Star Butterflies* automatically track and attack a target, dealing *Spectro DMG*. If there are already 5 *Collapsed Cores*, Shorekeeper's next *Basic Attack* hit will instantly convert a *Collapsed Core* into a *Flare Star Butterfly*.
